goal: Report disk read and index corruption errors explicitly instead of claiming transactions are missing
Alerts users and RPC callers to storage or index corruption instead of masking it as nonexistent data
agreement: Strong support for distinguishing read failures from missing transactions (yuvicc, ryanofsky)
Open question on design overlap with PR 34132 and release note wording (l0rinc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because disk read errors and corruption in transaction indexing were treated as missing entries
Surfaces index and database corruption immediately rather than masking it as nonexistent data

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because RPC and REST endpoints misreport disk read failures as missing transactions
Callers receive accurate failure details rather than false negatives during storage problems
